name: construction-pos
description: Point of Sale, inventory and accounts system for construction material shops in Pakistan

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pos/web && npm run build -w @pos/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pos/shared && npm run test -w @pos/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pos/server && npm run typecheck -w @pos/web
